svg.title: Four bounds against the actual response gap
svg.desc: All verified, strictly positive response-gap pairs. Diagonal dotted lines indicate equality. Decimal-enclosed gaps are shown at their midpoint; bounds use their certified upper endpoint. Zero-not-excluded or unresolved gaps are recorded rather than assigned a logarithmic value.
svg.title: Four bounds against the actual response gap
